point3.text: point3 {x, y, z}: a point of space, z up (the ground is the plane Oxy)

segment3.text: segment3 {a: [x, y, z], b: [x, y, z], length}; a and b in definition order

polygon3.text: polygon3 {vertices: [[x, y, z], ...], normal: [x, y, z], area}: a planar polygon of space in definition order; normal is the unit normal by the right hand of that order (of a face of a solid: the outward one), area is unsigned

plane.text: plane {p: [x, y, z], n: [x, y, z]}: p is the projection of the origin, n the unit normal oriented by the definition

polyhedron.text: polyhedron {vertices: [[x, y, z], ...], faces: [[i, ...], ...], edges: [[i, j], ...], area, volume}: a convex closed solid; faces are vertex index cycles counterclockwise seen from outside, edges index pairs, both in the canonical order of the operation (its face.k and edge.k outputs); area is the surface, volume positive

section.text: section {polygon: [[x, y, z], ...], faces: [[k, ...], ...]}: the polygon a plane cuts from a solid, counterclockwise about the normal of the plane; faces[i] are the indices of the faces of the solid side i lies on (two when it runs along an edge)

segment3.text: P = a + t (b - a); t is clamped to [0, 1]

point3.text: the input of point3.free: three finite numbers

pathParameter.text: as in the plane: the parameter of a point on a path

surfaceParameter.text: the input of point3.on_surface: P = P0 + u (P1 - P0) + v (Pn - P0) in the frame of the first corner of the face (Pn its last vertex); not clamped

volumeUnit: a value of kind volume compares within parity.length * S^3
